baseline_models.focus_anchor: أخرى تحبونها / نصر من الله / فتح قريب / بشر المؤمنين
baseline_models.mechanism: A deliberately desired second benefit moves from closedness into effective divine aid, is temporally near, and becomes emotionally perceptible through advance tidings.

activation_trace.role: The other-or-later branch marks a second benefit distinct from the preceding reward.
Clinging affection makes this second benefit an admitted object of human desire.
Aid that makes its recipient prevail supplies the operative force of the promise.
Opening a closure supplies the transition from blocked possibility to available passage.
Temporal nearness places that passage on an approaching horizon rather than only at the end.
Face-brightening news makes the future benefit affectively present before arrival.
Settled trust identifies recipients able to inhabit the promised nearness as assurance.

changed_reading.before: The ayah simply adds an imminent victory to a deferred reward.
changed_reading.after: The ayah stages a desired second horizon: divine aid converts closure into a near passage, while proclamation lets believers inhabit its approach before it is visible.

baseline_models.mechanism: Aid answers injury by restoring standing, while opening is the judgment that resolves a closed dispute; nearness is access to the deciding authority, and tidings are its first signs.

activation_trace.role: Redress for the wronged turns aid from raw superiority into restored right.
Judgment that settles a closure supplies the adjudicative mechanism of the opening.
Privileged nearness supplies access to the source of decision rather than mere short duration.
First visible signs let the verdict announce itself before full execution.

changed_reading.before: Victory is a favorable outcome in conflict.
changed_reading.after: Victory can be heard as imminent redress: a closed case is opened and decided so that withheld standing becomes publicly recoverable.

baseline_models.mechanism: Aid is a grant, opening is both the key and the storehouse it exposes, and nearness is favored access; the promise therefore concerns bestowed availability, not only defeated opposition.

activation_trace.role: Aid as a gift makes the benefit bestowed rather than mechanically earned.
The worshipped source locates the grant in divine agency rather than an autonomous process.
A key or opener makes access, not destruction, the means of change.
The opened storehouse supplies latent contents that become available through the opening.
Favored nearness makes the promised gain a change in access and standing.
Joy-opening news is the first experiential delivery of the still-unopened gift.

changed_reading.before: The opening is a single external event.
changed_reading.after: The opening is granted access: a key reaches latent provision, and the tidings already begin to deliver that gift as changed confidence.

context_deltas.mechanism: The repeated rupture between utterance and action places the focus imperative to announce good news under a performative test: credible tidings must be borne out by enacted alignment.

activation_trace.role: Face-brightening news anchors the focus command as consequential speech.
Spoken utterance supplies the verbal side of the saying-doing rupture.
Produced action supplies the missing realization against which speech is measured.
Attributing what is not realized sharpens the risk that proclamation outruns actuality.
The repeated action branch makes enactment, not repetition of words, the resolving term.
Severe aversion to ugliness supplies the moral cost of an unperformed announcement.

structural_cues: 61:2-3 repeats the same saying-without-doing construction before the focus imperative وبشر.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a repeated speech/action mismatch and a later command to announce; I infer that the command inherits a demand for enacted credibility; the live alternative is that the rebuke and the proclamation remain adjacent but independent.

changed_reading.before: وبشر is a consoling report about a future event.
changed_reading.after: وبشر is accountable speech: it brightens faces legitimately only when the community's conduct can carry the announced opening.

context_deltas.mechanism: The object of believers' love in the focus is set against what God loves in 61:4. The reversal makes desire reciprocal and gives aid a social mechanism: aligned persons become a joined load-bearing form through which opening can occur.

activation_trace.role: Clinging affection anchors the promised event as what believers love.
Prevailing aid is the focus effect whose social channel is being reconstructed.
The same affection branch reverses the lover and beloved, making divine and human desire face one another.
Alignment on one line supplies coordinated orientation rather than isolated desire.
Joining parts into a building turns persons into a composite mechanism.
Tight fastening supplies the load-bearing cohesion by which the composite holds.

structural_cues: The same root ح ب ب has God as subject in 61:4 and the believers as subject in 61:13.
The simile moves from صفا to بنيان مرصوص.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies reciprocal love wording and a tightly assembled formation; I infer that cohesion can be a channel of promised aid; the live alternative is that formation is only one loved deed and not a causal condition of the focus promise.

changed_reading.before: Believers desire a victory delivered to them.
changed_reading.after: Their desired opening answers a prior divine love for aligned action, so aid can arrive through a community that has become structurally capable of carrying it.

context_deltas.mechanism: The opening acquires an inward gate: orientation can bend, and the heart can be turned back from its face. Nearness is therefore not bare chronology but a promise received or obstructed through settled direction.

activation_trace.role: Inner disclosure or relief anchors opening as a change in inward accessibility.
The heart's inner kernel localizes desire at the vulnerable center of reception.
Settled security supplies the receptive state contrasted with deviation.
Departure from straightness supplies both the initial bend and its echoed intensification.
Turning a thing away from its face supplies the reversal that can make an opening inaccessible.
Gentle direction toward a path supplies the positive orientation against which the turn is legible.

structural_cues: 61:5 repeats زاغوا/أزاغ around the heart before contrasting guidance with deviation.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies deviation, an echoed turning, the heart, and guidance; I infer a feedback relation between chosen orientation and capacity to receive opening; the live alternative is a purely punitive sequence with no bearing on the phenomenology of 61:13.

changed_reading.before: A near opening is an unconditional date approaching from outside.
changed_reading.after: The opening also names inward availability: settled trust can receive it, while repeated deviation can turn the very organ of recognition away from it.

context_deltas.mechanism: The earlier tidings announce a later arrival by an identifying name within a chain of confirmation and clear signs. The focus command repeats this prospective technology: news trains recognition before the near event arrives, while leaving open the risk of misclassification.

activation_trace.role: The other-or-later item anchors a benefit still distinct from what is already in hand.
First visible signs make proclamation an anticipatory sensor rather than only emotional comfort.
The earlier act of tidings supplies a precedent in which first signs precede the announced arrival.
Lateness after what came before supplies the explicit temporal relay.
The non-dominant mapped branch contributes a visible identifying mark, making the name a recognition device.
Meaning disclosed by speech or sign binds what lies before, the clear proofs, and their claimed clarity into an evidentiary field.

structural_cues: 61:6 orders confirmation of what is before, tidings of what comes after, naming, arrival with signs, and hostile relabeling.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies an earlier prospective announcement, later arrival, an identifying name, and contested signs; I infer that 61:13's proclamation prepares recognition of an approaching opening; the live alternative is that the two acts of tidings share only genre, not mechanism.

changed_reading.before: The believers are told good news because the outcome will please them.
changed_reading.after: They are given an advance recognition frame: the announcement makes first signs of the near opening legible before arrival and guards, imperfectly, against hostile relabeling.

context_deltas.mechanism: A call toward wholeness is met by fabricated attribution and withholding of right. This context supplies the dispute that the focus's aid-as-redress and opening-as-judgment can settle.

activation_trace.role: Redress for the wronged anchors victory as restoration rather than mere dominance.
Judgment that resolves closure supplies the form of restorative opening.
A verbal call that draws its hearer supplies the offered direction of the dispute.
Freedom from harm supplies the wholeness toward which the call draws.
Withholding and confinement from a right supplies the injury requiring redress.
Fabricated falsehood supplies the counterfeit claim that keeps the case closed.

structural_cues: 61:7 places fabrication against God inside an ongoing invitation to الإسلام and frames it twice with ظلم.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies call, safety, fabrication, and withheld right; I infer that the near opening adjudicates this contested invitation and restores public standing; the live alternative is that فتح concerns military outcome without a forensic layer.

changed_reading.after: Divine aid redresses a suppressed claim: the opening decides between invitation and fabrication, releasing truth and its recipients from withheld standing.

context_deltas.mechanism: Mouths are literal openings used in an attempted closure of light, yet the light is brought to completion. This aperture inversion activates فتح as disclosure through the very field where opponents try to extinguish disclosure.

activation_trace.role: An aperture opened out of closure anchors the focus as released visibility.
First visible signs make the announced opening an early emergence of what cannot remain covered.
A flame becoming still and cold supplies the intended terminal closure.
Illumination supplies the content opponents try to close and God continues to expose.
An opening or outlet makes the hostile mouth an ironic aperture in the attempted extinction.
Arrival at completion reverses attempted extinction into unstoppable fulfillment.

structural_cues: 61:8 opposes ليطفئوا نور الله بأفواههم to والله متم نوره in one sentence.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies extinguishing, light, mouths as outlets, and completion; I infer a spatial reversal in which attempted closure helps define the promised opening as disclosure; the live alternative is that mouth imagery marks only futile speech, without an aperture relation to فتح.

changed_reading.before: فتح is a breakthrough against resistance.
changed_reading.after: فتح is also counter-closure: illumination finds an outlet inside the very scene designed to suppress it, and tidings are its first visible leakage.

context_deltas.mechanism: Truth is established, brought from hiddenness into public visibility, and extended over an encompassing field. Victory and disclosure therefore coexist inside فتح rather than competing as alternatives.

activation_trace.role: Victory as an opened outcome anchors prevalence as one live sense of the focus opening.
Disclosure through inner opening preserves an epistemic change alongside outward prevalence.
Forerunners make public manifestation detectable in advance.
Establishing and displaying a right supplies the content that manifestation vindicates.
Emergence from hiddenness supplies public visibility as the first motion of prevalence.
Encompassing totality supplies the field across which manifestation expands.

structural_cues: 61:9 moves from guidance and the religion of truth to ليظهره على الدين كله.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies established truth, emergence, and encompassing scope; I infer a sequence from disclosure to prevalence; the live alternative is that يظهره denotes dominance directly, with no epistemic phase.

changed_reading.before: The near فتح is victory understood mainly as changed power.
changed_reading.after: The near فتح can change visibility before or together with power: truth emerges, becomes recognizable, and only then or thereby prevails across the field.

context_deltas.mechanism: The trade frame links rescue to expenditure of wealth and self, but the focus names aid as a divine gift and an 'other' benefit. The near opening reads as surplus return within a transaction whose outcome exceeds equivalence.

activation_trace.role: A distinct additional item marks the near benefit as return beyond the previously named outcome.
Aid as grant prevents the transaction from collapsing into equal wages for effort.
An opened treasury supplies the image of latent value becoming available.
Trade seeking profit supplies the explicit exchange frame.
Escape by separation supplies rescue as the first return of the trade.
Exerting capacity under hardship supplies costly participation rather than passive purchase.
Possessed wealth supplies one invested medium.
The living self supplies the irreducible second investment.

structural_cues: 61:10 asks about a saving trade, 61:11 names its commitments, 61:12 names deferred returns, and 61:13 begins with وأخرى.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies trade, rescue, costly effort, two invested media, and an additional benefit; I infer a return structure in which near aid is surplus grant; the live alternative is that trade is only a teaching metaphor and وأخرى simply coordinates independent promises.

changed_reading.before: Near victory is one item in a list of rewards earned by sacrifice.
changed_reading.after: Near aid is a surplus return that makes committed action fruitful now, while its source as gift resists reducing divine response to a wage calculation.

context_deltas.mechanism: The preceding reward is protected interiority, continuous flow, and settled habitation; the focus's 'other' reward is near opening and first visibility. The sequence holds concealed dwelling and public breakthrough as two coexisting horizons.

activation_trace.role: The other-or-later branch explicitly differentiates the focus benefit from the preceding horizon.
Passage out of closure gives the second horizon an outward threshold.
First visible signs contrast with the protected interiority of the prior reward.
A garden concealed by growth supplies protected interior abundance.
Continuing provision supplies duration within the protected horizon.
Dwelling in a home supplies stable inhabitation rather than transitional breakthrough.
Attaining good with deliverance names the completed value of the first horizon.

structural_cues: 61:12 closes with ذلك الفوز العظيم; 61:13 reopens the list with وأخرى and shifts to قريب and an imperative of announcement.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a concealed settled reward followed by an explicitly other near opening; I infer a contrast between protected interior completion and public transitional breakthrough; the live alternative is a simpler temporal contrast between afterlife and worldly victory.

changed_reading.before: The ayah adds a smaller worldly bonus after the great reward.
changed_reading.after: It opens a second, structurally different horizon: settled hidden abundance and near public breakthrough coexist without either absorbing the other.

context_deltas.mechanism: The direction of aid reverses from 'help from God' to 'be helpers of God,' then moves through support into becoming publicly prevalent. The promise is therefore both divine source and human vocation, not passive rescue alone.

activation_trace.role: Aid that makes prevail anchors the benefit as coming from God in the focus.
Forerunners let the recruited community recognize support before full prevalence.
The repeated same aid branch reverses recipients into named helpers and makes agency circulate.
Coming into an actual state supplies vocation as something to become, not merely to admire.
The disciple-helper branch supplies a concrete human embodiment of aid.
Strength that supports supplies the divine reinforcement linking vocation to result.
Becoming supplies the transition into a new public condition.
Prevalence supplies the outward condition produced after support.

structural_cues: 61:13 says نصر من الله; 61:14 immediately commands كونوا أنصار الله and ends فأيدنا...فأصبحوا ظاهرين.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a source/object reversal of help and a sequence from becoming helpers through support to prevalence; I infer participatory circulation of aid; the live alternative is that human help is duty and divine help is sequel, related but not mutually conditioning.

changed_reading.before: Help from God is an external intervention received by believers.
changed_reading.after: Help from God recruits its recipients into becoming helpers; the promised opening is realized through a circuit of vocation, reinforcement, and public emergence.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This cross-domain reading is surprising because it activates seed, rain, watering, and channel branches inside conflict language. It remains anchored in تحبونها/نصر/فتح/قريب and is reinforced by the immediately preceding flow imagery; render it as a material analogy for how relief propagates, not as a claim that فتح lexically means irrigation.

activation_trace.role: A carried seed makes desire latent potential capable of growth.
Relieving rain supplies aid as an enabling medium rather than direct force.
Water released from an outlet makes opening the conversion of stored potential into flow.
Approaching the watering time supplies imminence as readiness for release.
Forerunners supply the first visible shoots or signs of the coming release.
Unimpeded flow supplies the adjacent downstream state of released water.
Widening until something flows supplies a close material analogue for فتح as opened circulation.

changed_reading.before: Aid acts by overpowering an obstacle.
changed_reading.after: Aid may also work like timely rain: an opening releases flow into latent seed, and tidings register the earliest growth before the full landscape changes.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: The near-delivery branch is zoological and therefore form-distant, but it remains attached to قريب and coheres with opening-as-beginning and tidings-as-forerunners. Render only as a birth-threshold analogy for imminence, never as the direct lexical sense of the phrase.

activation_trace.role: A later or other item supplies what is about to emerge after the first horizon.
An opening beginning supplies the threshold that initiates what follows.
Pregnancy near delivery supplies compressed imminence at the edge of manifestation.
Forerunners supply signs that the threshold has begun before the outcome is fully present.

changed_reading.before: قريب gives only a short interval until victory.
changed_reading.after: قريب can image a threshold under pressure: another outcome is near delivery, فتح is its beginning, and بشارة is the first sign of emergence.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This reading is surprising because it uses the packet's non-dominant ع د و to ع و د mapping and the morning branch beside أصبحوا. The recurrence remains anchored in near temporal opening and the explicit becoming-visible sequence; downstream prose must call it a split-root activation and a cyclical hypothesis, not an etymology of عدو or a denial of concrete victory.

activation_trace.role: Opening as a beginning keeps victory from being modeled only as terminal closure.
Temporal nearness supplies the approaching phase of each emergence.
The non-dominant mapped branch contributes return after departure, activating recurrence around the enemy episode.
Morning supplies a recurring opening of visibility after darkness.
Becoming supplies an actual transition rather than a static title.
Emergence into visibility supplies the state reached at this recurrent dawn.

changed_reading.before: The near opening is a once-for-all endpoint.
changed_reading.after: It may also name a recurrent dawn-pattern: support brings a community back into visible standing, and each opening begins another phase rather than ending all struggle.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: The useless-spark branch under ح ب ب is highly form-distant and should not replace the ordinary love sense. It remains focus-anchored and becomes diagnostically useful beside the completed-light context: render it only as a cautionary counter-image asking whether desire mistakes a flash of success for enduring illumination.

activation_trace.role: A brief useless spark supplies a deliberately unstable image for an immediately desired success.
First visible signs create the need to distinguish a true forerunner from a merely bright flash.
Sustaining illumination supplies the durable field against which the transient spark is tested.
Completion supplies the criterion separating enduring light from momentary excitement.

changed_reading.before: Whatever believers love in the near term transparently signals the promised good.
changed_reading.after: The beloved near event may need discernment: a bright success can be only a spark, whereas its validity is measured by whether it participates in the light's completion.

strongest_changes: The desired 'other' changes from passive rescue into a reciprocal vocation: help from God recruits helpers whose support becomes public prevalence.
فتح remains plural rather than resolved: breakthrough, adjudicative redress, gifted access, disclosure, and released flow coexist through distinct mechanisms.
بشر changes from emotional consolation into advance recognition and accountable speech whose first signs must be tested by action and completion.
The sequence preserves two reward horizons: protected settled interiority in 61:12 and near public transition in 61:13.
summary.what_was_special: The focus branches generated material, legal, epistemic, social, temporal, and affective mechanisms that context sharpened without forcing one final reading; even the split-root recurrence and spark activations remain live under explicit containment.
remaining_uncertainties: The omitted noun governed by وأخرى permits several scopes for what exactly is 'other,' even though the sequential contrast with 61:12 is strong.
The hydraulic, birth, recurrent-dawn, and spark models may be illuminating analogies or overactivation of distant branch images; they should remain exploratory.
The relation between divine aid and becoming helpers may be causal participation, exemplary sequence, or coordinated duties and gifts rather than strict reciprocity.
Public manifestation and military prevalence can coincide, but the packet does not force their temporal order.
